plan.notes: Source: official University of Nebraska Omaha 2026-2027 undergraduate catalog, Computer Science, Bachelor of Science page (https://catalog.unomaha.edu/undergraduate/college-information-science-technology/computer-science/computer-science-bs/); sequence transcribed from the catalog's official PDF export of that page (computer-science-bs.pdf), 'Four Year Plan - Start 1400' -- the standard term-by-term sequence for students who begin the major in CIST 1400. The catalog also publishes an alternate 'Four Year Plan - Start 1300-1200-1280' for students who begin with CIST 1300, CSCI 1200, or CSCI 1280 before CIST 1400; only the Start-1400 track is transcribed here. Catalog year 2026-2027 verified on 2026-09-30 (current catalog pages state 'Information based on 2026-2027 University of Nebraska at Omaha undergraduate catalog'). Transcription method: fetched the official catalog PDF via the catalog site's own link and transcribed the plan table by hand; titles transcribed verbatim as printed (e.g. CMST 1110 'PUBLIC SPEAKING FUNDS', CSCI 4830 'INTRODUCTION SOFTWARE ENGINEERING'). Caveats: the catalog calls this roadmap a suggested plan of study, not a contract -- advisors may adjust sequencing. Math/English placement exams may change the sequence (MATH 1950 requires placement). Prereq data: catalog states a grade of C or better in CIST 1400 and CSCI 1620 is the prerequisite for all subsequent CSCI courses; CSCI 1620 also requires CIST 1400 (and MATH 1300/1320/1370 placement-level math) per its course page. Student-choice slots (oral communication, science requirements, extension/concentration courses, GE electives, CSCI 3550 vs CSCI 4350) are choice:true placeholders; approved options are listed in choice_note. CSCI 4000 is a required 0-credit assessment course (required_zero:true). [2026-09-30: file renamed from uno-bs-computer-science.json — Day-1 filed University of Nebraska Omaha under the ambiguous UNO id; id now unomaha-bs-computer-science to avoid collision with University of New Orleans.]

courses.title: Natural/Physical Science Requirement with Lab -- student choice
courses.choice_note: Choose one 4-credit natural/physical science course WITH a laboratory from the catalog's approved Science Courses list (at least 2 disciplines across the two science slots, minimum 1 lab): lab options include PHYS 1054, PHYS 1154, CHEM 1014, CHEM 1144, CHEM 1184, GEOL 1104, GEOG 3514 (paired lecture+lab). Non-lab list: PHYS 1050, PHYS 1110, PHYS 2110, CHEM 1010, CHEM 1140, CHEM 1170, CHEM 1180, BIOL 1450, BMCH 2400, GEOL 1170, GEOL 1100, GEOG 1030, GEOG 1050, GEOG 1090, GEOG 3510.
